Resolution Testing checks if the defect is fixed. Regression Testing checks if unchanged features still work after fixing the defect. Previously working features are still functioning correctly Regression vs Resolution Testing
Resolution Testing checks if the defect is fixed. Regression Testing checks if unchanged features still work after fixing the defect. A fix for one bug might introduce new bugs in areas that were working earlier. Hence:
Both resolution and regression tests must be run after fixing a defect. Use of Automation in Regression Testing
Automated test scripts are very helpful here. After changes, some test cases might:
Become invalid (not useful anymore)
Become redundant (testing unaffected parts of code)
